question: Which famous santoor player was honoured with the Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan Award in 1998?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shivkumar Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shivkumar Sharma** is one of the most prominent and celebrated santoor players in India.
 
• He was honoured with the **Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan Award** in 1998 for his contribution to Indian classical music.
 
• Shivkumar Sharma is credited with bringing the santoor to the forefront of Indian classical music.
 
• He has received several prestigious awards throughout his career, including the Padma Shri in 1991 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2001.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan Award:**

 
 
• The Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan Award is a prestigious award given in the field of Indian classical music.
 
• It is named after the legendary sarod maestro Ustad Hafiz Ali Khan, who was a notable figure in the classical music domain.
 
• The award recognizes outstanding contributions and excellence in the field of Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Santoor:**
 
 
• The santoor is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer, a traditional Indian musical instrument.
 
• It has its origins in the folk music of Jammu and Kashmir.
 
• It is played using a pair of curved wooden mallets, and it has a characteristic shimmering sound.
 
• Shivkumar Sharma's efforts have been instrumental in popularizing the santoor in Indian classical music.
 
 
 
• **Shivkumar Sharma's Contribution to Music:**
 
 
• Shivkumar Sharma has composed music for several films, bringing the sound of the santoor to a wider audience.
 
• He has performed extensively worldwide, collaborating with various artists and promoting Indian classical music globally.
 
• His innovative techniques and dedication have significantly expanded the santoor's repertoire and scope.
